Counts and indicative costs are public aggregate observations, not displacement, net-price, payer, HTA, policy, regulatory, or calibrated evidence.

supported_fields.interpretation: Community prescribing coverage does not capture these specialist secondary-care observations; the positive SCMD rows independently demonstrate that PCA zero matches must not be interpreted as treatment absence.

sources.refresh_rule: Repeat against each annual PCA release and invalidate the coverage comparison if the dataset scope, terms, resource hash, identifier mapping, or repository commit changes.

coverage.medicine_identity_resolution: resolved from NHSBSA VMP SNOMED codes embedded in current SCMD rows
coverage.triangulation: The same NHSBSA data architecture yields zero community PCA matches but positive secondary-care SCMD observations, establishing dataset-scope divergence. Finalised 202603 comparator observations and provisional 202605 acoramidis observations are retained separately rather than silently pooled.
coverage.completion_assessment: WP2 source-family enumeration, latest-release hashing, medicine-identifier resolution, and PCA/SCMD coverage comparison complete as of retrieval time. Monthly longitudinal extraction and indication attribution remain outside the available public fields.

negative_or_deferred.reason: Acoramidis appears in provisional 202605 but not finalised 202603; await finalised 202605 before promotion beyond provisional context.
SCMD reports organisation, product, quantity, and indicative cost; it does not attribute an indication, counterfactual programme, or causal budget displacement.
negative_or_deferred.retry_condition: An attributable NHS decision packet supplies the missing programme fields.
